public.name: Dreamstime
public.summary: Stock photo agency where photographers upload images and earn royalties when they are licensed.
public.description: Upload your photos to Dreamstime's stock library. Images are reviewed before they go on sale, and you earn a royalty each time one is licensed. Royalties vary per licence and are not guaranteed.

opportunities.title: Sell your photos as stock
opportunities.summary: Upload photos to a stock library and earn royalties when they're licensed.

internal.commission_text: 10% of gross value of referred buyers' and contributors' transactions, guaranteed 3 years.
internal.qualifying_action: Referred buyer purchases or referred contributor sells

public.name: JoinBrands
public.summary: Marketplace where brands hire creators for product photos, videos and reviews.
public.description: Apply to brand jobs for user-generated content such as product photos, short videos and reviews. Pay varies by job, and some jobs include a free product instead of or in addition to cash.

opportunities.title: Create UGC for brands
opportunities.summary: Apply to brand jobs for product photos, videos and reviews.
opportunities.compensation_note: Pay varies by job; some jobs include a free product (not cash).

internal.commission_text: US$30 per referred brand; US$5 per active referred creator; 20% of JoinBrands service fees from referred brands for 1 year.
internal.qualifying_action: Referred brand's first paid campaign; referred creator's first paid job
